messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Elevated 502 rate detected on inference-gateway-prod (service: model-runtime). Auto-escalation to on-call initiated. Summary: 2.6% 5xx over last 5m, spike coincident with a set of model runner restarts.
maya: I'm on pager. seeing increased 502s from gateway → model-runner pool A. traces show healthcheck fails then segfault in model-runner logs. attaching last crash log snippet.
chris: thx @maya. can you paste the segfault stack or a snippet? I can start triage on the runner binary.
maya: ``
[2026-03-17T15:26:12Z] model-runner[pid:1423] SIGSEGV at 0x7ff...
Backtrace: 0x55a1b3... run_inference+0x2d
0x55a1c4... kv_cache_fetch+0x11
...
``
leo: paging in — I can try safe rollback to previous quantized model if we think a model change triggered this. Any recent rollouts to pool A?
anita: Ops: autoscaler shows pool A had a surge in evictions right before crash (OOMs reported). Could be memory regression with this quant profile.
chris: oh — I see a config rollout earlier: model: rdlw-v2-quant (rev: 20260317-0923) deployed to pool A at 15:20UTC. Might be correlated.
maya: impact: about 18% of customer requests to region-us-east are 502s right now. cust-success pinged with basic notice.
cust-success: we've alerted the top 3 affected customers; they are investigating impact. providing updates.
ops-bot: Running mitigation: draining new tasks from pool A, routing to pool B (compatible variant rdlw-v2-fp16) until healthy. ChangeID: route-20260317-01.
leo: initiating canary rollback: pin pool A to rev 20260307-1730 (pre-quant) and redeploying 1 replica to validate.
chris: while rollback spins up, collect core dumps + full gdb backtrace. maya, can you enable extra logging and upload /var/log/model-runner/core* to the incident artifacts?
maya: uploading now. also enabling runtime debug flags: --kv-cache-check=on --mem-guard=on.
anita: I've increased eviction thresholds on pool A to reduce noisy restarts. note: this is a temporary change, will monitor.
ops-bot: Traffic reroute complete. 90% now hitting pool B. 502s dropped to 3.1% in last 1m.
chris: good sign. request traces show gateway 502s map to runner SIGSEGV. this looks like a model+quant kernel memory corruption under certain seq-len patterns.
leo: rollout rollback is finishing. 1 replica healthy on old rev, running short sequence workload tests.
maya: short-seq smoke looks green. 0 segmentation faults in 10m.
cust-success: customers confirm reduced errors on their end. one reported timeouts earlier but now OK.
chris: next steps: 1) preserve core and heap profiler dumps for postmortem (I've started upload) 2) pin model variant for pool A to previous rev until root cause fixed 3) schedule a regression test for the quant profile with long sequences and kv-cache stress 4) open a bug in infra/repro with reproducer steps.
leo: will create rollback PR and lock the rollout for pool A. tagging @release to block auto-rollouts for 24h.
anita: monitoring CPU/GPU mem, no further evictions after threshold tweak + rollback.
ops-bot: Incident status: mitigation in place, error rate decreased to 0.9% across regions. Paging channel will remain open for 2h for follow-ups.
maya: filing initial incident summary and customer impact notes. adding links to artifacts: s3://rdw-incidents/1709456789/*
chris: assigning postmortem owners: chris (runtime), leo (deployments), maya (oncall log), anita (autoscaler config). ETA for draft: 48h.
cust-success: letting customers know we'll follow up with RCA and timeline. they appreciate the quick mitigation.
ops-bot: Pager cleared. on-call acknowledged: maya. Incident minimized at 15:57 UTC.
maya: thanks all. leaving notes: suspect quantized attention kernel regression triggered by long-context KV fetch pattern. will reproduce and add test.
chris: moving to post-incident channel for deeper debugging. closing thread here. :white_check_mark:
